newsitem.title: USA: MGM Grand boosts financing over $2.0 bln.
newsitem.headline: MGM Grand boosts financing over $2.0 bln.

text.p: MGM Grand Inc, owner of the MGM Grand hotel and casino, Wednesday announced new credit deals giving it the ability to raise over $2.0 billion for expansion plans.

MGM has a large slate of projects ahead including a $700 million addition to the MGM Grand in Las Vegas, a proposed $700 million hotel and casino in Atlantic City and plans to bid for a casino in Detroit that could cost over $400 million.

"The $2 billion financing package, when combined with our strong cash flow from existing operations, will give us the resources and flexibility to roll out our previously announced expansion projects and take advantage of other opportunities," Terrence Lanni, chief executive officer said in a statement.

Under the new financing, MGM Grand increased its credit line to $1.25 billion with the right to boost it further to $1.5 billion. The agreement allows MGM Grand to incur additional "pari passu" debt up to $500 million and unlimited subordinated debt if it meets certain financial covenants.
Finally earlier today, MGM also announced a shelf registration to issue up to $600 million of debt and equity.
